paths.description: Requested nouen game entry and redirect behavior; represents the named core task.
Resolved public Mobage home/catalog; represents navigation, news/game lists, responsive UI, performance, security, discoverability, and memory.
Game-ranking and news deep links; intended listing archetypes, both observed redirecting to the generic www portal.
Public account login; represents the primary form, cancellation/recovery choices, invalid submission, and auth methods.

findings.summary: The requested game URL does not reach the requested service.
findings.evidence: The recon probe navigated https://nouen.sp.mbga.jp and finished at https://sp.mbga.jp/, a generic Mobage game/news portal. The farm game journey is therefore unavailable from its public entry URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a stable game landing/launch route or return an explicit retirement page with explanation, alternatives, and support links.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in palette to the default light capture, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme, light-dark(), or color-scheme support.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens, preserving contrast in both modes.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not handled and existing contrast fails.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast capture is unchanged; the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast/forced-colors rules, while Lighthouse failed color-contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and verify essential text and controls with automated and visual contrast checks.

findings.summary: Route and state changes are abrupt.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no View Transition rules or API use on a multi-page portal with listing and authentication navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with reduced-motion-safe fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long-page navigation chrome does not respond to scroll position.
findings.evidence: The 2,882 px page has static chrome and no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or responsive scroll cue in the screenshot/CSS probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress/return affordance where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Navigation changes provide weak attention cues.
findings.evidence: Representative listing/news routes switch or redirect without directional transition, marker, highlight, or focus cue; the CSS probe found none of the corresponding primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve focus and add restrained directional or highlight feedback for route and section changes.

findings.summary: The custom navigation drawer is not built with a semantic dismissible primitive.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains hidden drawer controls and custom layer classes, while the platform probe found no dialog, popover, or details element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover with declarative control and light-dismiss, while preserving focus and escape-key behavior.

findings.summary: Dense legacy chrome crowds the content and scales poorly on wide screens.
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot stretches list rows and rules across 1,280 px while retaining phone-like chrome; the mobile first viewport is dominated by nav, campaign, and section bars.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce a centered reading/container width, simplify repeated chrome, and let the primary game content lead.

findings.summary: Components rely on page-wide sizing rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container/container-type rules; the desktop screenshot shows phone-oriented list components stretched full width.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards/lists containment and use container queries for spacing, typography, and multi-column adaptations.

findings.summary: Several primary controls are too small or have no visible custom focus.
findings.evidence: The focus probe measured registration/login controls at 45×31 px and several elements reported outline-style none; the game navigation is only 38 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet a 44×44 CSS px target where possible and add clear :focus-visible styling without removing native outlines.

findings.summary: A generic system error appears without a recovery action.
findings.evidence: Both mobile and desktop captures display “システムエラーが発生しました。” over the game list, with no retry, details, or support action.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the transient dead-end toast with a contextual error state that explains impact and offers retry or support.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.1 s and FCP 2.5 s; the independent trace measured LCP/FCP about 2.82 s. CLS and TBT were good.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP candidate, shorten document/resource latency, and defer non-critical images and scripts.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is image-heavy and weakly cached.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 66 requests/1.20 MB, including 1.04 MB of images, parser-blocking CSS/scripts, and many large assets without useful cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Modernize and cache image assets, lazy-load below-fold images, and defer confirmed non-critical parser scripts.

findings.summary: Accessible names and image alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 44 of 45 img elements without alt; the home form probe also found an unlabeled textarea.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text, decorative images alt="", and every input an associated label or accessible name.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s color-contrast audit failed on the public home page.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA and retest every state, including high contrast and disabled controls.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus treatment are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found no main landmark; the DOM probe found no semantic landmarks and several focusable items computed outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav/header/footer landmarks, preserve a logical heading order, and provide an obvious :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: The viewport disables user zoom and some targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The viewport declares maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and the focus probe measured 31–38 px controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove zoom restrictions and size controls for comfortable touch while preserving narrow-screen reflow.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; recon found multiple links implemented as javascript:void(0) and anchors without href.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation and buttons for actions, keeping link text descriptive.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The probe found no canonical or hreflang; sitemap.xml could not be fetched, and the requested nouen host redirects to another host.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish consistent canonical URLs and a reachable sitemap, and make redirects reflect the intended public URL lifecycle.

findings.summary: Share and entity metadata are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The page has no JSON-LD and og:description is empty despite representing a game platform; the requested subdomain has no distinct share target.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite structured data and complete Open Graph metadata tied to visible content.

findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie attributes are unsafe.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff and all other inspected policies are absent. All four cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure and appropriate SameSite on every cookie, deploy HSTS/nosniff, and introduce a nonce/hash-based CSP.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks a phishing-resistant passkey option.
findings.evidence: The public login offers password and federated providers but no WebAuthn/passkey path; the password field also omits a current-password autocomplete token.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration/authentication as a first-class option, retaining federated and recovery alternatives.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Header evidence shows no clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS, CSP, or origin-isolation signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, strict Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, then assess Trusted Types/origin isolation.

findings.summary: Runtime failure handling is not resilient.
findings.evidence: The home path renders a system-error toast without recovery while the HAR records an aborted HTTP analytics request.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle failed requests explicitly, avoid insecure endpoints, and keep core content/actions available with retryable state.

findings.summary: Network and HTTP failure states do not provide recovery.
findings.evidence: The observed system error has no retry/cancel/support action and no explanation of which operation failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide specific timeout/network/error states with retry, back, and support actions, and preserve context.

findings.summary: Submitting an empty login form gives no visible or accessible error feedback.
findings.evidence: After activating Login with empty fields, the screenshot and probe were unchanged; fields were not required/invalid, aria-invalid remained absent, and no role=alert appeared.
findings.suggestedFix: Require the fields, validate after interaction, mark invalid controls, move focus appropriately, and announce a concise error summary.

findings.summary: Login inputs do not expose precise autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: Email uses autocomplete="on" and password has no token instead of username and current-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Set autocomplete="username" on the identifier and "current-password" on the password; preserve password-manager and paste support.

findings.summary: Image assets use legacy formats and eager loading.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 39 legacy-format images, no modern formats, and 16 below-fold images without lazy loading; HAR attributes 1.04 MB to images.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve WebP/AVIF where appropriate, add responsive sources, and lazy-load below-fold content images.

findings.summary: The page’s visual asset budget is disproportionate to its simple catalog UI.
findings.evidence: Images account for about 87% of 1.20 MB transferred, including duplicated 181 KB sprites and several 150 KB sprites; 52 requests are from asset/ad subdomains.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace duplicate sprite sheets with smaller modern assets, cache them aggressively, and defer non-critical campaign/game media.

taskList.title: Restore or explicitly retire the nouen game route
Deploy secure cookies and defensive response headers
Repair accessibility names, landmarks, contrast, zoom, focus, and target size
Add humane login validation and password-manager semantics
Replace generic failures with actionable retry and recovery states
Modernize, cache, and defer the image/resource pipeline
Make navigation and layouts semantic, container-aware, and less noisy
Repair crawlable links, canonical/sitemap, and rich metadata
